description: This file defines the interface and class structure for a Bluetooth plugin within the WPEFramework project. It includes declarations for the Bluetooth class, which implements plugin and JSONRPC interfaces, as well as internal methods, constants, and helper classes related to Bluetooth device management, discovery, and event handling.

classes.name: DiscoveryTimer
classes.description: A helper class to manage discovery timer events associated with the Bluetooth plugin.

classes.name: Bluetooth
classes.description: Main plugin class managing Bluetooth functionalities, device discovery, connection, and event notification.

methods.name: getApiVersionNumber
methods.description: Retrieves the API version number of the Bluetooth plugin.

methods.name: startScanWrapper
methods.description: Wrapper method to initiate Bluetooth device scanning.

methods.name: stopScanWrapper
methods.description: Wrapper method to stop Bluetooth device scanning.

methods.name: isDiscoverableWrapper
methods.description: Wrapper to check if Bluetooth device is discoverable.

methods.name: setDiscoverableWrapper
methods.description: Wrapper to set the Bluetooth device discoverability.

methods.name: getDiscoveredDevicesWrapper
methods.description: Wrapper to retrieve list of discovered devices.

methods.name: getPairedDevicesWrapper
methods.description: Wrapper to retrieve list of paired devices.

methods.name: getConnectedDevicesWrapper
methods.description: Wrapper to retrieve list of connected devices.

methods.name: connectWrapper
methods.description: Wrapper to connect to a Bluetooth device.

methods.name: disconnectWrapper
methods.description: Wrapper to disconnect from a Bluetooth device.

methods.name: setAudioStreamWrapper
methods.description: Wrapper to set audio stream on a device.

methods.name: pairWrapper
methods.description: Wrapper to pair with a device.

methods.name: unpairWrapper
methods.description: Wrapper to unpair from a device.

methods.name: enableWrapper
methods.description: Wrapper to enable Bluetooth functionality.

methods.name: disableWrapper
methods.description: Wrapper to disable Bluetooth functionality.

methods.name: getNameWrapper
methods.description: Wrapper to get the Bluetooth device name.

methods.name: setNameWrapper
methods.description: Wrapper to set the Bluetooth device name.

methods.name: sendAudioPlaybackCommandWrapper
methods.description: Wrapper to send playback commands.

methods.name: setEventResponseWrapper
methods.description: Wrapper to set event responses.

methods.name: getDeviceInfoWrapper
methods.description: Wrapper to get information about a device.

methods.name: getMediaTrackInfoWrapper
methods.description: Wrapper to get media track info.

methods.name: getDeviceVolumeMuteInfoWrapper
methods.description: Wrapper to get device volume/mute info.

methods.name: setDeviceVolumeMuteInfoWrapper
methods.description: Wrapper to set device volume/mute info.
